description: Urban Development Area - Expansion & Declaration of part of Monaragala Pradeshiya Sabha area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration and expansion of the Monaragala Urban Development Area. It describes the metes and bounds of the area being designated for urban development, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, Grama Niladhari divisions, and specific geographic features. The content focuses on land use planning and development rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
